power_system.description: Select the power system type (power transformer) the meter is wired to.

VT_connection.description: Select how many voltage transformers (VT) are connected to the electrical power system.

VT_primary.description: Set the voltage transformer (VT) primary and secondary voltage ratings.

VT_secondary.description: Select the voltage transformer (VT) secondary voltage rating.

CT_on_Terminal.description: Define how many current transformers (CT) are connected to the meter, and which terminals they are connected to.

allowed_sets.I1_I2: 2 CTs connected to I1 and I2 terminals
allowed_sets.I1_I3: 2 CTs connected to I1 and I3 terminals
allowed_sets.I2_I3: 2 CTs connected to I2 and I3 terminals
allowed_sets.I1_I2_I3: 3 CTs connected to I1, I2, and I3 terminals

CT_Primary.description: Enter the size of the CT primary, in Amps.

CT_secondary.description: Select the size of the CT secondary, in Amps.

sys_frequency.description: Set the system frequency for the electrical power system.

phase_rotation.description: Set the phase rotation for the electrical power system.
